title: The Ultimate 7-Day Road Trip & Itinerary for Madhya Pradesh
summary: Maximize your week with this perfectly paced 7-day itinerary covering heritage, nature, food, and culture.
content: A week is the perfect duration to fall in love with the magic of Madhya Pradesh. This comprehensive, hour-by-hour itinerary takes you from the bustling capital city of Bhopal deep into scenic valleys and historic fortresses. You will spend Day 1-2 exploring Bhopal Upper Lake and Indore Rajwada Palace, Day 3-4 traveling to hidden hamlets, Day 5 encountering local wildlife, and Day 6-7 enjoying cultural dances, shopping, and tasting traditional Madhya Pradesh Signature Dish.
